title: ID0378824-DC/Si-D/TR-[Multi-45 devices] Downgrade FW
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The 45 chargers with the IDs below want their FWs to be downgraded to v4.0.11. These devices are constantly giving ‘Error code:7’ and are the critical ones among the devices with v5.0.19 installed.
Root cause: FW Bug
Solution: FW update to v5.0.21
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status:
11/09/2024 :
Handover NOC-->Experts
